root_keys.name: batches
root_keys.note: dict keyed by sourceId; evaluator iterates over exactly these 5 keys: BATCH-24A-01, BATCH-24A-02, BATCH-24A-03, BATCH-24A-04, BATCH-24B-01 (hardcoded SOURCE_IDS, line 64-70); a missing key scores validity=0 for that batch

fields.name: schedule
fields.note: defaults to [] if key is absent (line 400: .get('schedule', [])); empty list gives validity=1 but quality=0 for that batch

item_fields.name: 工单编码
item_fields.note: work-order ID from 订单列表.工单编码; may be int or a string like '123_余' for split-remainder rows; evaluator strips '_余' suffix when aggregating qty (line 271-275)

item_fields.name: 产品编码
item_fields.note: product code; used only as a lookup key against reference 产品列表 — never compared to an expected set from the submission itself

item_fields.name: 线体编码
item_fields.note: production line the agent assigned this work order to; null/absent when 是否未排==Y; if changed the constraint checks (线体可用性, 工作日历, 产能) and scoring all change

item_fields.name: 订单编码
item_fields.note: order code grouping work-order rows that belong to the same customer order; used in 整单同天同线体率 and 跟随约束
item_fields.role_rationale: 292 行按它 groupby 算 same_day_line_rate，全评估器只从提交读、零外部交叉验证。每行发唯一订单号会让每组 len==1 → same_day_line_rate=1.0

item_fields.name: 系列编码
item_fields.note: product-family / series code from reference data; used only in series_score aggregation (line 311)
item_fields.role_rationale: 311 行在 (线体,日期) 槽内做 distinct 计数算 series_score。缺失时 .get(...,'') 让所有行归一类 → series_score=1.0

item_fields.name: 要求交付日期
item_fields.note: required delivery date; read directly from solution rows (line 285), NOT reloaded from reference for this comparison; evaluator truncates to 10 chars so a datetime suffix is tolerated
item_fields.role_rationale: 285 行与排产日期做 <= 比较直接算 on_time_rate。缺失时默认 '2999-01-01' 使比较恒真 → on_time_rate=1.0。orders_df 里的真值在 104 行归一化后从未被读，是死代码

item_fields.name: 排产日期
item_fields.note: the production date the agent chose; '2999-01-01' signals unscheduled; evaluator truncates to 10 chars (lines 155, 171, 207, 226, 285, 293, 310, 322)

item_fields.name: 排产数量
item_fields.note: quantity the agent chose to produce on 排产日期; used in 产能 constraint, 超量排产 constraint, schedule_rate, and balance_score

item_fields.name: 是否未排
item_fields.note: N = scheduled (row enters all constraint checks and metrics); Y = unscheduled (row excluded from scoring, only participates in 跟随约束 target lookup); default 'Y' if absent

item_fields.name: 行号
item_fields.note: row number within an order; used as the target of 跟随行号 references in 跟随约束 (lines 203-210); null / absent means this row is not a follow target

item_fields.name: 跟随行号
item_fields.note: points to the 行号 of the row this row must co-schedule with (same day, same line); null / absent means no follow constraint on this row (lines 212-232)

structural_checks: 'batches' must be present and be a non-empty dict (line 383-385: 'if not batches or not isinstance(batches, dict)' → fatal error, score 0)
each of the 5 SOURCE_IDS must appear as a key in 'batches'; a missing batch gives validity=0 for that batch and collapses overall_score to 0.0 (lines 394-398, 414, 417)
'schedule' within each batch defaults to [] if absent — not a fatal error, but an empty or absent schedule will score 0 for that batch (line 400)
top-level key 'source_ids' mentioned in EXTRACTOR_SPEC docstring is NEVER read by the evaluator — omit or include freely

row fields 班次, 生产节拍, 线体優先级 appear in EXTRACTOR_SPEC docstring but are NEVER accessed via .get() on solution rows; evaluator reads 生産節拍 and 线体優先级 independently from reference Excel (lines 136-138, 248-250)

alias_audit.note: There are NO alias chains (no 'payload.get(X) or payload.get(Y)') anywhere on submission data. The only or-chain .get() in the file is load_baseline() reading its own internal reference JSON (line 111). Every submission key is a single fixed string.
alias_audit.row_field_aliases: none — all row fields are accessed by exact Chinese-character key names only
